Marks with the conventional value 10 the outlets on the map of the drainage directions: the cells that drain out of the map or into no-data cells.

**Toolbox folder:** Dem Manipulation<br>
**Status:** Tested<br>
**Keywords:** Outlets, Drainage directions, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Antonello Andrea, Franceschi Silvia<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Markoutlets`

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |

**Outputs**
